name: primitives-effects-highlight

frames.best_why: A crisp grey highlight sits behind Analytics with the cursor over that item and the whole header visible.

tagline: A grey marker slides behind whichever nav link you hover.
summary: A dark header bar with a brand, five nav links and an avatar; a rounded highlight moves under the link the pointer is on and fades away when it leaves.
appearance: A wide, rounded dark bar on black holds a white rounded-square logo with the name Northwind, five small grey nav links and a tiny round avatar at the far right.
behaviour: Pointing at a link fades a lighter rounded rectangle in behind it, and moving between links slides the marker across with a spring. It disappears when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Northwind brand with Overview, Analytics, Customers, Billing and Settings links plus an avatar photo.
search_phrases: nav links with a sliding marker
hover background that follows the item
dark toolbar with active item fill
use_when: A row of nav or tab labels needs a clear moving marker for the hovered or active item.
avoid_when: It is a bare wrapper with no look of its own, so you must supply highlight colours and adapt it to light themes.
customise: Each item is a child with a value, and mode, hover or click, transition, class names and a controlled value are props; the bounds measuring is fixed.
weight_why: One absolutely positioned rectangle measured and animated; idle when nothing hovers.

a11y.note: The marker only follows the mouse, never focus, and aria-selected is put on plain buttons without a tab role.

issues: The highlight grey is only slightly lighter than the header, so the hovered item is faint.
polish_why: Tidy dark header and a smooth slide; the faint highlight makes the hover state too subtle.
